review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and system designs. Use AI tools to assist with test-case generation, edge-case discovery, automation scripting, requirements analysis, and defect investigation. Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework. Preferred Qualifications: Experience testing Java/Spring Boot and Angular applications.
